result.line: Base contracts are executor vaults: ALMProxy 0x2917956e..09cA doCall onlyRole(CONTROLLER) and ALMProxyFreezable 0x92d7..DDF9 doCall onlyRole(ALLOCATOR_ROLE) (MissingRole reverts from fresh address, verified source); only permissionless surface is PSM3 0x1601843c..347E swaps (6,285 Swap events / 7d, 67 distinct senders, median ~20k USD, idle USDC 999.5k) which pay the caller 0 protocol reward; Base TVL 468.5M USD (llama)
